body:
Similar to https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/25371 this allows the constraint list to get lazily/dynamically loaded, rather than having to be available at creation of the instance.

Relates to https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-iceberg/pull/1578 since https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-iceberg/pull/1733 got merged

comments.body: Thanks - could you target `main` then we can slap it with the backport label?
